source_document: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Department of Consumer Affairs, Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
disclaimer: Rule text summarized for engineering use. Official Gazette text is authoritative. Applicability must always be determined before validation. Checks marked manual_only are not automatically verified.

scoring.weight: Relative weight of this requirement in the compliance percentage. Declared here (never in code) so a regulatory re-prioritisation is a data edit. Omit to fall back to the engine default (2.0 when critical, else 1.0).
scoring.critical: A confirmed failure of this requirement is a critical non-compliance. Read from this file; the check-type mapping in the engine is only a fallback for rules that do not declare it.
scoring.excluded_from_score: manual_only checks are never scored; a NOT_APPLICABLE outcome is excluded only when the kind is INAPPLICABLE (out of scope by law/packaging/confirmed category). An outcome that is NOT_APPLICABLE because evidence was missing counts as UNVERIFIED.

rules.title: Name and address declaration
rules.description: The label must declare the name and address of the manufacturer, or packer, or importer of the commodity (whichever is applicable).
rules.requirement: Manufacturer / packer / importer name and address declaration must appear on the package as applicable.
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6; DoCA mandatory declarations guidance
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Common or generic name of commodity
rules.description: The common or generic name of the commodity must be declared on the package.
rules.requirement: Common/generic name of the commodity must be declared.
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Net quantity declaration
rules.description: The net quantity must be declared in standard units. This check verifies the DECLARATION is present and structurally valid; it cannot verify the physical quantity inside the package.
rules.requirement: Net quantity declaration with standard unit (mass/volume/length/number).
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6; standard units under Legal Metrology Act, 2009
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Month and year of manufacture / pre-packing / import
rules.description: The month and year of manufacture, pre-packing or import must be declared where applicable.
rules.requirement: Month/year of manufacture, pre-packing or import must be declared where applicable.
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Retail sale price (MRP) declaration
rules.description: The retail sale price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes must be declared. Unit sale price is NOT a substitute for MRP and is checked separately.
rules.requirement: MRP / retail sale price declaration must be present. A unit price (₹/g) does not satisfy this.
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Consumer care details
rules.description: Consumer care details (phone/email/address) should be declared where applicable.
rules.requirement: Consumer care contact details declared where applicable.
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6 (as read with DoCA guidance)
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Best before / use by declaration
rules.description: Best before or use-by must be declared where applicable (e.g. foods with shelf life). Applicability depends on product category and is treated cautiously when classification is uncertain.
rules.requirement: Best before / use-by declaration where applicable.
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Country of origin for imported packages
rules.description: Country of origin must be declared on imported packages. Image evidence alone usually cannot establish that a package is imported, so this check is typically NOT_APPLICABLE unless import evidence exists.
rules.requirement: Country of origin declaration on imported packages.
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Legibility of declarations
rules.description: Mandatory declarations must be legible and prominent. From an image, Pocket can only report whether declarations were VISIBLE and readable; physical font height in millimetres cannot be verified without scale calibration.
rules.requirement: Declarations visible and readable in the supplied images; physical size verification remains manual.
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 9 (Manner in which declaration shall be made) and Rule 6(1)
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

rules.title: Placement of declarations on the package / principal display panel
rules.description:
Rule 6(1) requires every package to bear, on the package itself or on a label securely affixed to it, a definite, plain and conspicuous declaration. Rule 9 requires the declarations to be legible and prominent (its sub-rule (2) bars a declaration made so as to be concealed or obscured). Rule 7(1) provides that for a package of capacity 10 cubic centimetres or less the principal display panel may be a card or tape affixed firmly to the package, which shall bear the required information. 

What image evidence CAN establish: which VIEW of the package (front / top / side / ...) each declaration was read from, and whether the watched declarations were seen on a panel-type view. What it CANNOT establish: that the photographed surface IS the principal display panel as a matter of law — that depends on how the pack is presented for sale, and Rule 7(1) allows a card or tape on small packages to serve as it. A shortfall therefore yields UNCERTAIN (manual verification), never FAIL.
rules.requirement: Mandatory declarations are borne on the package or on a label securely affixed to it, legible and prominent, and appear on the surface that functions as the principal display panel.
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1) (declarations to be made on every package), Rule 9 (manner in which declaration shall be made) and Rule 7(1) (principal display panel; card/tape for packages of 10 cm³ or less)
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

params.exempt_rule7_1: Rule 7(1): for a package of capacity 10 cm3 or less the principal display panel may be a card or tape affixed firmly to the package bearing the required information — verify the pack form before treating a panel shortfall as a breach.

rules.title: Batch / lot number declaration
rules.description: Batch or lot number must be declared on pre-packaged commodities where applicable (e.g. where manufactured goods carry batch coding).
rules.source_reference: LM (PC) Rules, 2011 — Rule 13 (read with applicable exemptions)
rules.amendment: Original 2011 text; subject to later DoCA amendments

manual_only_rules.title: Standard pack sizes
manual_only_rules.description: Certain commodities may only be packed in specified quantities. Verification requires the applicable current standard-pack list for the commodity and cannot be automated safely from an image alone. Not automatically verified.
manual_only_rules.requirement: Standard pack compliance — manual verification against the current notified list.

manual_only_rules.title: Exemptions applicability
manual_only_rules.description: Rule 4 specifies exemptions from certain Chapter II requirements. Exemption applicability depends on package type, intended use and institutional/industrial context which image evidence generally cannot establish. Exemptions are never auto-applied when classification is uncertain.
manual_only_rules.requirement: Check whether any Rule 4 exemption applies — manual determination.

manual_only_rules.title: Permissible errors in net quantity
manual_only_rules.description: Maximum permissible error for net quantity depends on physical measurement with calibrated equipment. A photograph cannot verify physical quantity. Not automatically verified.
manual_only_rules.requirement: Physical quantity within permissible error — requires calibrated weighing/measuring.
